newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - Banco O'Higgins started.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Banco O'Higgins started.

text.p: -- Oppenheimer & Co said on Tuesday it was starting coverage of Chile's Banco O'Higgins with a neutral rating.

-- In a report, analysts Stephen Dreskin and Daniel Chace wrote, "After completion of the Banco O'Higgins and Banco de Santiago STG pb.SN merger OHG will be Chile's largest bank, with an 18 percent market share ..."
-- They added, "It may take as much as 18 months to realize the anticipated $40 million annual cost savings from the merger."
-- Banco O'Higgins was unchanged at 25 in late-morning trade in New York.
